headline: Source: Jets rookie WR Cooper Jr. put on IR with sprained ankle
summary: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, has been placed on injured reserve with a sprained ankle, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: At least one team has called Steelers about Joey Porter Jr.
summary: Friday's deep dive from ESPN into the far-simpler-than-it-seems contract issue between the Steelers and cornerback Joey Porter Jr. included a contention that the team has not received any "serious inquiries" regarding a trade.
